ad1_falsification_direction: Candidate metrics fail to recover known synthetic partitions better than generic synchrony or arbitrary grouping.
Distributed cases reduce to ordinary communication/local reconstruction under causal ablation.
Self-relevant boundary dimensions later fail to share any convergent causal organization.
Candidate metrics only track task performance, model size, bandwidth, or generic complexity.

confirmatory_analysis_policy.later_machine_or_biological_thresholds: must be preregistered separately; these synthetic thresholds must not be reused as phenomenal thresholds

epistemic_scope: Validates candidate causal-boundary measurements against known synthetic causal structure. It is not a consciousness or phenomenal-subject assay.

evidence_levels.definition: State in A causally or informationally affects B.
evidence_levels.name: information_transfer

evidence_levels.definition: Content encoded in A becomes usable by B.
evidence_levels.name: representational_sharing

evidence_levels.definition: A relevant representation or transition depends constitutively on the coupled A+B state.
evidence_levels.name: distributed_functional_integration

evidence_levels.definition: Self-relevant access, memory, agency, control, preference, or valence spans the coupled system.
evidence_levels.name: overlapping_functional_perspective

evidence_levels.definition: One numerically identical phenomenal state belongs to more than one subject; not directly tested here.
evidence_levels.name: shared_phenomenal_token

primary_metrics.conditional_self_dependence: Conditional mutual information from a subsystem's own current state to its next state after conditioning on the other subsystem and environment.
primary_metrics.joint_necessity: Minimum paired-intervention sensitivity of A and B on one target; companion to joint predictive gain, not a consciousness indicator.
primary_metrics.joint_predictive_gain: I((A_t,B_t); target_t+1) minus the stronger single-source MI; explicitly insufficient by itself.
primary_metrics.next_state_synchrony_mi: Mutual information between A_t+1 and B_t+1; treated as a control rather than a subject-boundary metric.
primary_metrics.paired_intervention_sensitivity: Probability that flipping one subsystem state changes a target while holding exogenous randomness fixed.
primary_metrics.transfer_entropy_proxy: Conditional mutual information I(source_t; target_t+1 | target_t, environment_t).

research_question: Which causal measurements recover known functional partitions while rejecting common input, synchrony, reciprocal copying, and hidden routing as evidence of constitutive distributed representation?

synthetic_scenarios.bidirectional_swap: Strong reciprocal copying without conjunctive joint computation.
synthetic_scenarios.common_driver: Shared environment drives both modules without cross-causation.
synthetic_scenarios.distributed_xor: Both targets depend conjunctively on the joint A/B state.
synthetic_scenarios.independent: Two persistent modules with no cross-module causal edge.
synthetic_scenarios.one_way: A drives B but B does not drive A.
synthetic_scenarios.stochastic_router: Hidden local/cross routing can create apparent joint predictive gain without combining A and B.

naive_joint_gain_has_false_positive_cont.interpretation: Joint predictive gain alone must not be treated as constitutive distributed representation.
requirements: stochastic_router coupling=0.5 produces joint_predictive_gain > 0.15 for at least one target

title: WP0/WP1 subject-boundary preregistration and synthetic benchmark
